resumes.text: Backend engineer with 6 years building Python REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, Flask, and FastAPI. Familiar with CI/CD and containerized deployments.
Senior ML engineer: model development, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, feature engineering, MLOps, model serving.
Frontend developer experienced with React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, responsive design, accessibility, webpack, and Vite.
Data engineer with experience building ETL pipelines, Spark, Airflow, SQL, data warehousing, and cloud storage (AWS).
DevOps / SRE with Kubernetes, Terraform, monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana), CI/CD, Docker image pipelines, and cloud networking.
Mobile developer with Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) experience, plus React Native projects and API integration.
Data scientist with experience in statistical modelling, Python (pandas, numpy), visualization, and communicating results to stakeholders.
Full-stack engineer: Node.js, Express, React, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Docker, and cloud deployment experience.
Cybersecurity analyst with experience in vulnerability assessment, OWASP, SIEM tools, penetration testing, and incident response.
Database administrator skilled in PostgreSQL, replication, backups, performance tuning, and query optimization.
NLP researcher with experience in transformers, Hugging Face, text embeddings, information retrieval, and model fine-tuning.
QA engineer experienced in automated testing, Selenium, Playwright, unit testing, integration testing, and test strategy.
Product manager with technical background working closely with engineering teams, defining roadmaps and specs.
Graphic designer with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, branding, and collaborating with marketing and product teams.
Research engineer in computer vision with OpenCV, PyTorch, model deployment, and image annotation pipeline experience.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Design and implement RESTful APIs using Python frameworks. Work with PostgreSQL and containerised deployments. Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Build ML pipelines and deploy models. Requires Python, TensorFlow or PyTorch, scikit-learn, and experience serving models as REST APIs.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (React)
jobs.description: Develop responsive UI using React and TypeScript. Experience with webpack, Vite, HTML5, and CSS3 required.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Responsible for ETL, Spark jobs, Airflow orchestration, SQL and data warehouse design. Cloud experience (AWS/GCP) preferred.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Manage Kubernetes clusters, Terraform IaC, CI/CD pipelines, Docker images and monitoring stacks like Prometheus & Grafana.

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer (Android)
jobs.description: Develop Android applications in Kotlin, integrate with backend APIs, and ship to Play Store.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Perform statistical analysis, build predictive models, and communicate insights. Proficiency with Python, pandas, and visualization tools.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Work across frontend and backend: Node.js, Express, React, and relational databases. Deploy scalable web applications.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description: Conduct vulnerability assessments, work with SIEM, and support incident response and threat hunting activities.

jobs.title: Database Administrator
jobs.description: Manage PostgreSQL databases, perform tuning, backups, and high-availability setups.

jobs.title: NLP Researcher
jobs.description: Research and prototype NLP models, experience with transformers, embeddings, and Hugging Face ecosystem.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Design and implement automated test suites using Selenium, Playwright, or similar tools. Strong test engineering skills.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Technical)
jobs.description: Lead product strategy, write specs, work with engineering to deliver features; technical background preferred.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.description: Create branding and marketing visuals using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator; collaborate with product and marketing.

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description: Develop CV models using OpenCV and PyTorch. Experience with image annotation and deployment of models to production.
